d: Will Vaibhav Suryavanshi be dropped from Team India's Playing 11 for the IND vs NZ series? Is Gautam Gambhir planning another surprise with his team selection? In this episode of Zero Cricket Knowledge, we (Chayan Rastogi & Abhishek Manchanda) roast the possible selection decisions, discuss Vaibhav Suryavanshi's place in the playing eleven, and analyse the team combination debate ahead of India vs New Zealand. Will Vaibhav get another opportunity, or could he miss out due to India's changing plans? We bring you unfiltered cricket opinions, selection debates and our signature cricket roast.…
